name: @gjsify/gtk-quartz-native-darwin-x64
description: darwin-x64 prebuilt native library + GObject-Introspection typelib for @gjsify/gtk-quartz-native. Installed automatically on darwin/x64 as an optionalDependency of that package (ADR 0017) and skipped everywhere else. Contains no JavaScript.
